text: สีดา สมควรอยู่คนเดียว to be honest i started with yuval dayan שרק תחייך. And the song הלב שלי by omer adam and ishay ribo. Every word that i dont understand i write it down and translate it then i would start using the words as an addition to my vocabulary. Slowly slowly you will learn to speak in a whole sentence plus you can also read and write. Hehe. Still try your best to have a little conversation in hebrew with your partner. Good luck 🙏🏼🙏🏼
